chain.text:
**Estate**
18 ha: 11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc; clay and flint soils.
62,000 bottles average; 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail hit western plots.

**Certification**
Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023, earliest certification 2026.

**Sales**
Export 41 percent, mainly Belgium and Japan.
Japanese importer requires sulphites under 60 mg/l.

**Documented failures**
2022: tank 4 controller drifted 3 degrees for two days; bulk loss 11,000 euros. Controllers now calibrated pre-harvest; tank 4 has a second probe.
2023: 900 mislabelled bottles recalled; label proofs need two signatures.

**Rules**
No irrigation on western plots.
Harvest dates set from three consecutive mornings of sugar and acidity, never the calendar.
Tanks above 28 degrees cooled within four hours.

**Open items**
Lighter bottles proposed 2025; importer unconfirmed, no cost comparison.
Eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided; vines 54 years old, yields down 30 percent in five years.
